description: Pure enrichment module exposing compute_score(metadata) that returns (float, dict). CRITICAL: domain_trust is flat 80.0 across all servers — provides zero discrimination. Must read MULTIPLE fields: registry_source, age_days, download_count, dependency_count, publisher_verified, stars. Must derive meaningful variation from domain metadata, registration age, or registry_source patterns. No DB writes, no network, no imports of protected modules. Returns evidence dict listing fields used and partial scores for auditability.
